text_block_list.text:
One day, Голд Шипп comes to the
trainer's
office...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Why, hello there, Trainer. Sure is lovely
weather
we're having today, don't you
think?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Goodness, why do you look so startled?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I daresay you seem a little off today. Are
you
feeling well?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: You don't seem like yourself, either.

text_block_list.text:
Well... If you must know, I've been
having strange
headaches of late.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
...Ah, speaking of which, I feel one
coming right
now—ow, ow, OW!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Whaaa? I'm the one and only Golshi!
Who else
would I be?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Ugh... All that shouting's made my
headache even
worse...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп seems to be plagued by bad
migraines.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
